title: 发布仅一个月：周活冲上41.8万，势头只算温和？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I just broke some news on the Bloomberg. Grock Bot, the AI agent that SpaceX AI put out in August, topped 400,000 weekly users recently.
segments.zh: 我刚在彭博上发了条消息。SpaceX AI 八月推出的 AI 代理 Grock Bot，近期周活用户突破 40 万。

segments.en: That data effective September 14th, 418,000 users of the AI agent, which represent a 24% week on week jump.
segments.zh: 截至 9 月 14 日的数据显示，该 AI 代理有 41.8 万用户，环比增长 24%。

segments.en: Interesting because they released, but back on August 11th, right?
segments.zh: 有意思的是，他们是在 8 月 11 日发布的，对吧？

segments.en: There's been so much focus in the last 24 hours on this being the moment of the AI agents, particularly around muse.
segments.zh: 过去 24 小时里，很多人都在关注这是 AI 代理的关键时刻，尤其是围绕 muse。

segments.en: Muse is a consumer-focused product from Meta. Grock Bot, a much more enterprise-focused product, but it shows some pretty modest momentum
segments.zh: Muse 是 Meta 面向消费者的产品。Grock Bot 则更偏向企业端，但显示出一些温和的势头。

segments.en: for SpaceX AI, the AI unit of SpaceX.
segments.zh: 这是 SpaceX 旗下 AI 部门 SpaceX AI 的表现。

segments.en: Shares kind of went back to our session highs after we put that report out.
segments.zh: 我们发布报告后，股价回到了盘中高点。

segments.en: Check it out on the terminal and on Bloomberg.com, the stock up one and a half percent.
segments.zh: 可在终端和 Bloomberg.com 查看，股价上涨 1.5%。
